_comment: Only MCP servers that require no setup (no API keys, no connection strings). Omitted: brave-search, weather, github, postgres, cosmic-llm-memory.

servers.label: Shell (safe command execution)

servers.label: Filesystem (read/write files)
servers.note: Access to your home directory; no API key.

servers.note: Fetches URLs and converts to markdown; no API key.

servers.label: Skills (agent skills / tools)
servers.note: Uses Luna skills folder; no API key.
